evals.prompt: this is an instagram post i made, the lettering was generated by AI so there is no font. can you make me a real font file from it? the heading should become the bold weight.
evals.expected_output: A project folder with Regular and Bold OTF/TTF/WOFF2, a specimen comparing the re-typeset text to the image, a README listing traced vs composed characters.
